nav.d: A suggested reply in your customer’s dialect that you approve

seo.title: Reply to Google Reviews Across Branches | SAAYT
seo.description: All branch reviews in one inbox with suggested replies in the customer’s dialect — a person on your team reviews and approves every reply before it posts

h1: No review left without a reply
lead: Every review from every branch lands in one inbox with a suggested reply in the customer’s own dialect. Your team edits if needed and approves in one tap

why.h2: More people read your reply than you think

items.d: A review and its reply are read by everyone deciding whether to visit, not only the reviewer
Google advises businesses to reply to reviews and says replies show you value your customers
A negative review left for days suggests nobody is listening
Filter by branch, rating and unanswered reviews
A review in Saudi dialect gets a reply close to that dialect and an English review gets an English reply
Every reply stays a draft until someone on your team approves, edits or rejects it
Set greetings, apology style and banned words and every draft follows them
Branch managers see their branch and operations sees everything
See which branches reply fast and which need follow-up

steps.d: It appears in the inbox with the branch and rating
SAAYT suggests a reply in the customer’s dialect and your voice
Review, edit, approve and it posts to Google

guard.d: SAAYT never buys, removes or writes fake reviews and follows Google’s policies

faq.a: No. Every reply waits for approval from someone on your team

faq.q: Can you remove a negative review?
faq.a: No. Removal is Google’s decision. You can report reviews that break its policies and SAAYT helps you reply professionally
You choose: close to the customer’s dialect, simple Modern Standard Arabic or English based on the review language
